title: Ender Dragon Drops Equipment
description: The ender dragon will drop gear with high level enchantments when killed.
body:
When killed, the Ender Dragon will drop a random piece of equipment from the following list with a high level enchantment applied. If that equipment is used in an anvil to try to get a higher level of that enchantment, vanilla mechanics will reset it to the normal maximum. This prevents these more powerful levels from being combined.

Treasure enchantments are excluded. The only ones that can be applied are enchantments that can be found in the enchanting table that have a higher than 1 maximum level.
